scheme_name: Grant of Quality Certification Reimbursement of Charges
other_conditions: Applicant must be a Micro, Small or Medium Enterprise (MSME) operating in Tamil Nadu
Application must be submitted within 1 year from the date of certification
benefits_summary: Reimbursement of up to ₹2,00,000 for National Level Certification and up to ₹10,00,000 for International Level Certification.
